verdict.rationale: Manufact runs an automated publish checklist that audits servers for protocol compliance and platform readiness, including live end-to-end checks. It also offers a readiness scan against any MCP URL, with public checklist scores in its MCP catalog. These are inspections of listed servers, but they target compliance and readiness, not malicious or vulnerable behavior. Missing for 10: security or malware scanning of servers, vulnerability or dependency analysis, detection of malicious tool behavior (e.g., prompt injection or data exfiltration), any gating of agent use on security results, and independent corroboration.
